review_text: We had dinner here. Food was pre-ordered and when we arrived, the food had already been served on the table. Food ordered : deep-fried squids for 2, chilli squid for 2, grilled golden snapper (jenahak), chicken tom yum soup for 2 and vegetable soup for 2. (for 2 people - this is how to order, you have to mention how many people will eat the food) 6 plates of plain rice. 1 Ulam set (local salad) Drinks ordered : iced Nescafe and iced coffee. Plain water is FOC. Food review : deep-fried squids, the portion for two people was big. Taste wise, it was bland on its own. You have to dip in chilli sauce. Chilli squids - the color was red but it was not hot. Look can be deceiving here. Grilled golden snapper - it was already cold when we started eating so I didnt really enjoy it. Suggestion to owner : this dish must be served hot to customers. Chicken tom yum soup - portion was adequate. There were vegetables such as carrot and cauliflower. Taste of tom yum was not hot enough. Also, the soup was cold. Vegetable soup - the portion was big. However, it was not for vegetarians as there were strips of chicken added. Taste was on the bland side, and it was oily. Ulam set was not fresh. Price : RM130++ (+) points - pre-order is allowed, so you dont have to wait long for food. - plain water is FOC. - ample parking space for customers. - a lot of tables to cater for customers. - staff were courteous. - the restaurant is well lit. (-) points - pre-order is allowed, so you tend to get cold food when you arrive. This is because the food has been prepared earlier. - taste of food in general is just OK. Not on the delicious side. Will I return? Probably I have to hunt for another place.

review_text: This restaurant is somewhat famous in Perlis. The food is fresh and the price is good. I ate for 9 people that day and ordered two big fish, a whole kilogram of sotong and 1kg of prawns. There are others that are almost over 300. . It s so delicious that I bring my relatives and friends over for dinner every time I come back. Remember to reserve a spot in advance.

My friend and I have no problem with the location, cleanliness or facilities. But when it comes to places to eat, the main topic must be the quality and taste of the food. This is last nights dinner menu; Grilled stingray Salted egg octopus Butter fried shrimp Apprenticeship Have you ever eaten grilled fish with coconut milk? Once I eat it, it feels strange, its ok to eat again, but when its over, I cant swallow it because Im too sick of the taste of coconut milk even though Ive had sambal. When asked if coconut milk is the default seasoning for grilled fish. Ayooo, that should be asked by the customer. The salted egg cuttlefish also failed because I expected this restaurant to cook Chinese style, apparently it was fried with the egg, and my friend and I ended up eating it. Fortunately, the shrimp still eats even though it doesnt taste as expected. The moral of the story is that I made a mistake when I went to a Malay store and was itching to order Chinese cooking style...
review_translated_text: Saya dan kawan tiada masalah dengan lokasi, kebersihan atau pun kemudahan. Tapi bila datang tempat makan mestilah tajuk utama kualiti dan rasa masakan. Ini adalah menu dinner malam tadi; Ikan pari bakar Sotong telor asin Udang goreng butter Ulaman Pernah tak korang makan ikan bakar dengan santan? Sekali makan rasa dah pelik ok lagi makan tapi bila dah hujung mmg tak boleh telan disebabkan terlalu muak dengan rasa santan walau dah cicah sambal. Bila tanya santan is default perencah untuk ikan bakar. Ayooo itu sepatutnya kena tanya customer. Sotong telor asin pun failed gak pasal aku expect kedai ni akan masak chinese style rupanya die goreng dengan telor tu end up aku dan kawan xleh makan dah rupa masakan kuah taruk telur kacau2 taraa berketul2 la telur tu bersama sotong dan kuah. Nasib baiklah udang leh lagi makan walau rasa dia tak seperti diharapkan. Moral of the story memang silap aku gi kedai melayu gi gatal nak order chinese cooking style...

review_text: His food is delicious.. but its a bit challenging to buy. 1. Parking is a bit difficult because the parking lot is on the side of the road and there are seriously many people. 2. There are two queues there. The left one is for the baked bread, the right one is for glutinous rice, peknga (pancakes), capati. The right line is here, pay there. The left line can be paid directly at the payment counter. 3. There are also other stalls such as dip noodles, pasembur, satay, tiow cake, fish satay, etc. (picture no. 2). Everything is ordered at that stall and paid there. 4. There is a section for nasi kerabu etc next to the payment counter (picture no. 3). Im not sure how to pay there because we didnt buy it there. 5. There is a waffle stall near the water counter. Order and pay there. Here tell him what table number he will send later. 6. We sit upstairs. Windy and beautiful scenery. Many other people have shared pictures. Once seated, you can call the sisters upstairs to order water (you can order water at the table, the others order at the stall and bring it up yourself). His ice tea is the best.. At first it was strange that there were so many people, but after eating I understood why so many people eat there. Its delicious. The atmosphere by the rice fields makes you even more hungry. Anyone who comes to visit their grandmother in Perlis must come here. No regrets even if the queue is a little long.

Nope clean the table yourself. To get self-service food, you have to stand in line for a long time, its okay to stand in line even if its long and you finally get food and have to go back and forth to take food and bring it to the table. Then I went to my sister because she was queuing to order water, so the employee took the order for water and I asked the person who sent it for water, she admitted yes... so my sister and I went to the table and ate the food we were waiting in line for. Look at other people who came late to get drinking water first... when I told the employee who took the order, he said yes... I cant wait anymore.. I have to wait and the water that I ordered didnt arrive. My family and I decided to go and pay for food without waiting for the water that didnt arrive. When paying, when I was reprimanded, the cashier said that I was the only one who said that. Before that I looked at the customer at the table next to me waiting for water. He went to pay straight away, even said to cancel. I have a heart again, so let me know and reprimand. But it was answered like that. We understand that there are many customers, not enough staff. I was angry, I told him to go back. Im not asking for weird things, Im reprimanding basic things. 1st come 1st served. Table cleanliness, I didnt talk to the cashier, I just added it in Google reviews. Angry, its nice to be answered with pearls. We leave a review so that lessons are taken seriously.

place_name: Hai Thien Seafood Restaurant Hai Tian Hai Xian
Hai Thien Seafood Restaurant Hai Tian Hai Xian
review_text: The go to seafood restaurant in Kuala Perlis. Its located at a strategic place near the seaside. It about 300-400 meters from Kuala Perlis jetty. Ive been patronising this restaurant over 25 years... before they moved to current location,  it was located on a wooden platform not far from Kuala Perlis jetty. (In between the jetty and LKIM) Eventime when I am back to Kuala Perlis; my in-laws will treat me dinner at this restaurant. The foods were deliciously good. Especially when they were in the previous location. Over the years the oroginal cook has retired and new cook took over. It was still nice then until around 5 years back. The taste no longer as good. E.g food taste more sugary and I gets thirsty after meals. Possible the over use of MSG. My favourite was sea catfish asam fried with dried chilies(the thick gravy dish).  Last I had the soury was more like from vinegar.(acid ascetic). Ikan 3 rasa (3 flavour fish I.e. sweet,sour salty)was also disappointing the last visit. Basically I cant remembered much as the foods was so so... oh the price also have move up one one notch too. There is a Satay An(Satay is skewed & grilled meat) stall  that has moved from the previous location togather with restaurant there to the currentocarion. The Satay still as good as before.

place_name: Hai Thien Seafood Restaurant Hai Tian Hai Xian
Hai Thien Seafood Restaurant Hai Tian Hai Xian
review_text: My first time here and im super impressed !!! Heres the breakdown : LOCATION Near to the Beach and easy to find. AMBIANCE Very simple and easy going restaurant, the typical average seafood restaurant with a simple layout. Cleanliness is acceptable. Toilets are clean. SERVICE Service was fast like really fast, we waited no longer than 15mins for all the food that we ordered. 8 dishes in total. Staff was efficient and friendly. Very attentive to all of our request. WAIT TIME Usually 30-45mins, before you get a table. Be patient as it is worth the wait. F&B QUALITY Id say its pretty good and tasty. 8 out of 10. We liked the soft shell crab the most and the udang lipan cili kering. That was really really good. The drinks are freshly made, we had the ambra asam boi. Delish. PRICE This is what surprised me the most. For all the 8 dishes we ordered, we expected the bill to come at around RM500 plus, as that is the usual. But it came to only RM250. Walauwei. CONCLUSION If youre looking for a GOOD and CHEAP seafood restaurant, this restaurant ticks all the boxes. Definitely worth the wait and visit. You will not disappoint. Highly recommended. Ive also post the menu for your reference. Enjoy !!!

review_text: Great food and great service. It s my first time here on my friends suggestion. Got a live band with a great singer just tooooooo loud. Just to let you know that you have to scan QR Code to get the menu and call the waiter to order.

Overall experient is ok. However there are some room of improvement. Regarding to the service, we got our balkhanat lamb chop after everybody had finished for 10 minutes. Perhaps this is an isolated case but hope the management will have a way to monitor this. Second thing is, they used corn starch to thicken the mushroom soup. Thus, the quality is not up to my expectation for the price, RM 10. The soup also very salty but it is fine if you intended to dip it with bread. Third thing also they used corn starch for the curry buttermilk chicken and the butter flavour is mild. Despite of this, the surrounding is excellent. You have the feeling either you are in Sarawak, Mexico or Spain. The decoration for me is marvelous. The star for tonight is the cheese chicken chop. I think this is the best of all. The lamb chop although we didnt order at medium, the cook had prepared this last night and it is excellent. I also like the corn salad which accompanied the western dishes. The carbonara was also good. The staffs were also friendly and Chortiez is clean without any doubt.
The price wise is great not so pricey and the food come with the best condition and so good. Love it so much. Will definitely come again

TFF Cafe apparently has a unique business model. The premise itself actually only served coffee and tea drinks, similar to those in Starbucks or other chic cafe. However, they call upon under SME and business owners to display and sell their foods on the shelves and fridges inside the cafe. The cafe owner vouches for the quality and within a certain period of time, if the sales of the food is bad, they will be removed from the store. For patrons of the cafe, this means one thing. The menu constantly changed all the time, meaning that each new visit is a chance to find new dishes as well. I bought a nice cream horn in a box, worth around RM 8.00 and it was light and tastes amazing. The drinks are good, although a bit too sweet for me, but its nice once in a while. Its a really great place to find both local or fusion food, and its takeaway-friendly as well. Come here and grab a quick bite!

review_text: I came here for the first time, was amazed by the crowd that are dining at this cafe. It has a good spread of food, as its name suggests, this place is popular with ikan Keli, catfish. They have various cooking methods, like deep fried, masak chilli and curry. The fish was prepared well, it has no muddy taste whatsoever. The deep fried one is very crispy. The chilly version is too sweet to my liking. I am impressed with the fried chicken and also ayam bakar (bbq chicken drenched in sauce). The bbq chicken is so tender, even the chicken breast is soft and flavourful. The ayam bakar sauce complements the chicken well. It has a nice burnt smell which adds a nice touch. Fried chicken is equally tender, the marination is done well. Every piece of meat is flavourful, crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside. I love the sauce provided too. They even have tempoyak sambal! The tempoyak smell isnt so intense but its nice. Sambal hijau is also good. Water is provided free of charge. There are cups next to a water dispenser. Those cups have a strong dish detergent odor. So its like drinking a detergent flavoured water. Seriously its just the smell hahaa. There is also a garden with a lot of flowery plants where most people come for photo check-ins and Instagram stories. Parking is ample. With the large crowd inside, there are still enough parking spaces for more crowds to come. That is great. The food is great, reasonable price. Overall rating is at 4.5/5. 0.5 point deduction is for the cups that smells like detergent. I will revisit.

The best mamak restaurant in Perlis, located at Kompleks Tok Arau, Arau. Open from 10 am to 11 pm. The famous dish here is the ayam goreng. The size is large and cooked to perfection. Since it has a steady wave of customers from the late morning, the ayam goreng is served hot and fresh all the day. Currently, Yasmeen sells the ayam goreng for RM 4.50 (potong 8) and RM 5 (potong 4). Other famous dish here includes ayam madu and janggut sotong goreng. My other preference is the ayam ros. Apart from these, Yasmeen Restaurants offers varieties of thosai such as Masala Tosai, Tosai telur, Tosai Cheese, Tosai Tisu and Tosai Paper. I could claim, this is one of the mamak restaurant that offers tosai in Arau apart from Reyas Nasi Kandar which is located in front of Masjid Negeri Arau and other nearest outlet you can find tosai is either in Kangar or Changlun. The chutney is the best and made sincerely from the cooks heart. Most probably the same quality of chutney you can find perhaps in PJ and Kuala Lumpur i.e Shaaz Restaurant in Sunway PJ.The teh tarik is also made to perfection although the less sweet version is my preference. The nan is good and it is one of my favourites. The only setback here is the tandoori chicken. Usually very dry and not juicy unlike the one in Pakistani restaurants. However, one greatest setback is currently all the goreng2, thosai, puri will be served after 4.30 until stock finish. Apart from the food, the cleanliness of the restaurant is excellent. The surau is very clean but it could accommodate only like 3-4 person at a time. Currently  they are using two robots to serve drinks for the customers. The first of its kind in Perlis. If you are coming for lunch, make sure you park your car at the proper parking since nowadays, the police like to spot check especially at the peak hours of the business.

review_text: The foods taste good and waitresses are friendly and polite but the foods served kind of slow.

This dining establishment offers a unique experience reminiscent of a bygone era, transporting patrons 50 to 60 years into the past with its nostalgic charm. It provides a sense of stepping into the shoes of someone from an earlier generation. The eatery serves two main meal times: breakfast and dinner. The breakfast menu is particularly impressive, both in its delicious offerings and the breadth of traditional selections, evoking the dietary customs of older generations. Highly recommended are the Nasi Lemak, Nasi Impit with kuah kacang, and the Roti Bun Kluang   each dish is a standout in flavor. The service is both swift and commendable, with staff members who are notably amiable. Dinner, while offering a narrower selection compared to breakfast, maintains high standards in taste and quality. The Mongolian Beef Rice comes especially recommended for its exceptional flavor. Parking is provided on-site, though spaces are somewhat limited.

The masak lemak daging salai is a must try dish. The gravy is thick and very flavourful. Its not spicy but it came with sambal petai for those who prefer theirs spicy. The Peknga served with gulai ikan termenung is also very nice, especially the gulai ikan. The fish is fresh and not overcook. The mee kari and kari laksa are also the dish to have if you come for light lunch. The gravy is nice but I could use some more shredded chicken and condiments - that would surely the cherry in top! Overall, Ngulang Kopitiam is a must visit eating places in Perlis. It is a hidden gem in Perlis and you wouldn t find this kind of kopitiam elsewhere!

The makcik admitted they are understaff to cater so many customers coming. Regarding to the food, my general comment, all the kuah(gravey) is thick and rich. But if you come due to settings and decorations, Ngulang Kopitiam should be considered.

You can also find other food like satay, sizzling noodle, cucur udang, laksa, shawarma, dessert etc. Good location & easy parking. Recommended

There is a wide selection of shops and food to choose from here. The price is cheap and very reasonable. There are delicious foods and some that taste normal. Went to eat here two days in a row and it is very suitable to bring the family to eat here. His village fried rice is delicious and his fried rice is the best. Arabic rice is normal. His water is delicious. Ambience is the best for hanging out and eating with family and friends. Its just that parking is very difficult because there are three famous food shops in the area. There are different types of payment and its very easy.
review_translated_text: Terdapat banyak pilihan kedai dan makanan boleh dipilih di sini. Harga yang murah dan sangat berpatutan. Ada makanan yang sedap dan ada juga yang rasa normal. Dua hari berturut pergi makan disini dan sangat sesuai untuk bawa keluarga makan disini. Nasi goreng kampung dia sedap dan nasi goreng dia terbaik. Nasi arab dia biasa biasa je. Air dia sedap. Ambience sangat best untuk lepak dan makan bersama keluarga dan kawan kawan. Cuma parking amat susah sebab terdapat tiga kedai makanan yang famous area sini. Terdapat pelbagai jenis pembayaran dan sangat memudahkan.
label: positive

This is a Chinese restaurant in Perlis located near moral uplifting society (   ) Kangar. The decorations of the restaurant is rather unique (big mango), and its rather yellow in color.. you wont miss this restaurant for sure. Stepping into the shop, we were greeted with a lot of paintings and antique wood display items. To me, everything seems here and there. I have tried 3 dishes. Signature tofu, pickled radish french bean and also a sweet and sour pork (   ). Tofu is soft and nice. The crispy mushroom added a nice texture. However if eaten together, I felt the mushroom taste a little too overpowering. I was told they use enoki mushroom for that.. but it smells and tastes like grey oyster mushrooms. Picked radish french bean is too sweet to my liking. Would love it more if it were savory instead of sweet. I guess they use sugar to caramelize the pickled radish. I guess their pickled radish is the sweet type, so the adding of sugar is rather unnecessary. The     is very tender. Love how they prepare the meat. The size of the meat is very uneven, (they are equally tender despite the large variation in size). Its just aesthetically not so pleasing. The sauce is okay, I find the smell of worcestershire sauce (correct me if Im wrong) too strong. Overall, the food is okay, not superb. That is just based on the 3 dishes I ordered. review_text: Reyas nasi kandar is one of the mamak restaurant apart from Restoran Ismail which offers thosai as breakfast. Once it serve idli  but after the current MCO, it no longer sells idli which is I think unfortunate. Located near to Masjid Negeri Arau, it is not hard to find the stall. The chutney is not too bad, although I still believe the chutney served in Yasmeen is the best and the version perhaps could only be found next in KL and Selangor. review_text: A Review of The New Perlis Gastronome Upon arrival at the newly unveiled eatery nestled in the heart of Perlis, the pastoral charm of the locale immediately beckons. As a seasoned culinary connoisseur, my expectations were cautiously optimistic. The menu promised a traditional fare, and I promptly ordered their Nasi Lemak and Kacang Pool. Both dishes were a dance of robust flavours, harmoniously orchestrated. The generosity of the establishment was further noted in the ample proportions of their beverage servings, decidedly above the commonplace. The service was impeccable; the staff exuded a warmth and efficiency that speaks volumes of the ethos of this nascent establishment. The swiftness with which our fare was served was commendable. It is my earnest aspiration that they sustain this calibre of service and culinary excellence as they voyage through the gastronomic realm. The eatery s rustic setting amidst a paddy field does come with a quaint caveat - the presence of mosquitoes, a minor inconvenience for those of us endowed with a particular allure for the winged critters. Our nocturnal visitation veiled the potential scenic vista offered by the paddy fields, yet the promise of a majestic view during the daylight hours lingered in the cool night air. As the night descended upon the verdant expanses, the soft murmurs of content patrons resonated through the breezy tranquillity. It was an experience that transcended mere culinary satisfaction. The Perlis Gastronome is not just a new eatery; it s a promising sojourn into rustic charm and authentic flavours. I entreat the connoisseurs and casual diners alike to grace this establishment and revel in its nascent promise.

review_text: Restoran Ismail is one of those early Mamak Restaurants in Perlis and still survive until today. The business starts at early morning (7 am) and close late at night. In Perlis,  not many mamak outlet offers variety of thosai such as Masala Thosai in the morning. Restoran Ismail is an exception. It serves Masala Thosai and Poori in the morning. Ismail also offer beriani at Saturday and Sunday. Few new menus such as roti masala also offered. Close to the roundabout, it is an option for those who wants mamak dish before reaching Kangar.
